rule.name: HardcodedSecret
rule.message: Read this secret from the environment or a secrets manager and inject it: this value is a hardcoded secret.
rule.description: A secret-named variable, field, setter, builder method or map key that holds a secret-looking literal.

property.name: xpath
property.value: let $words := function($s) { tokenize(lower-case(replace(replace(replace($s, '([a-z0-9])([A-Z])', '$1 $2'), '([A-Z]+)([A-Z][a-z])', '$1 $2'), '[^A-Za-z0-9]+', ' ')), ' ')[. != ''] }, $trimmed := function($n) { replace(string-join($words($n), ' '), '(?: (?:value|raw|str|string|text|plain))+$', '') }, $letters := function($text) { replace(string-join($words($text), ''), '[0-9]', '') }, $secretName := function($n) { matches(replace($trimmed($n), '[ 0-9]', ''), '(?:password|passwd|pwd|passphrase|secret|token|credentials?|apikey|privatekey|accesskey|secretkey|authkey|signingkey|encryptionkey|hmackey|jwtkey)$') and not(matches($trimmed($n), '(?:^| )(?:eos|bos|pad|unk|cls|sep|mask|next|page|continuation|cancellation) token$')) and not(matches($trimmed($n), '(?:^| )(?:masked|redacted)(?: |$)')) }, $candidate := function($v) { not(matches($v, '\s')) and not(matches($v, '^(?:\*+\w{0,4}|x+|<.*>|\[.*\]|\$\{.*\}|\$[a-z_]\w*|\{\{.*\}\}|\{\w*\}|%s|%\(\w+\)s|:[a-z_]+|changeme|change-me|todo|example|dummy|placeholder|redacted|none|null|undefined|your[-_ ].*)$', 'i')) and not(matches($v, '^(?:[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]+|[A-Za-z]+(?:[._:/-][A-Za-z]+)+|[a-z][a-z0-9_-]*(?:[./][a-z0-9_-]+)+|(?:~|\.{1,2})?(?:/[\w.-]+)+/?|\^.*\$|\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}(?:T[\d:.]+(?:Z|[+-]\d{2}:?\d{2})?)?)$')) }, $looksSecret := function($v) { string-length($v) >= 6 and $candidate($v) and ((matches($v, '\d') and matches($v, '[A-Za-z]')) or count((matches($v, '[a-z]'), matches($v, '[A-Z]'), matches($v, '\d'), matches($v, '[^A-Za-z0-9]'))[.]) >= 3) }, $shape := function($v) { matches($v, '(?:^|[^A-Za-z0-9_])(?:AKIA[0-9A-Z]{16}|gh[pousr]_[A-Za-z0-9]{30,}|xox[abprs]-[A-Za-z0-9-]{10,}|[rs]k_(?:live|test)_[A-Za-z0-9]{20,}|sk-(?:proj|ant|live|test)-[A-Za-z0-9_-]{20,}|django-insecure-\S{6,})') or matches($v, '-----BEGIN (?:[A-Z]+ )?PRIVATE KEY-----') or (matches($v, '^(?:jdbc:)?[a-z][a-z0-9+.-]*://[^\s/:@]+:[^\s/@]+@', 'i') and $looksSecret(replace($v, '^(?:jdbc:)?[a-z][a-z0-9+.-]*://[^\s/:@]+:([^\s/@]+)@.*$', '$1', 'is'))) or (matches($v, '^(?:bearer|basic|token)\s+\S+$', 'i') and $looksSecret(replace($v, '^\S+\s+(\S+)$', '$1', 'i'))) or (matches($v, '[?&;]password=[^&;\s]+', 'i') and $looksSecret(replace($v, '^.*[?&;]password=([^&;\s]+).*$', '$1', 'is'))) }, $hard := function($v, $n) { not($shape($v)) and not(matches($v, '^[a-z][a-z0-9+.-]*://', 'i')) and not((matches($v, '^(?:[a-z][a-z0-9]*(?:[_-][a-z0-9]+)+|[a-z]+(?:[A-Z][a-z0-9]*)+)$') and matches($letters($v), 'password|passwd|pwd|passphrase|secret|token|credentials?|apikey|privatekey|accesskey|authkey|signingkey|encryptionkey|hmackey|jwtkey')) or string-join($words($v), '') = string-join($words($n), '')) and ($looksSecret($v) or (string-length($v) >= 8 and matches($v, '[a-z][A-Z]') and $candidate($v) and matches($letters($n), '(?:password|passwd|passphrase)$'))) }, $text := function($n) { if ($n/self::InfixExpression) then string-join($n/*/@ConstValue, '') else string($n/@ConstValue) }, $values := function($e) { $e/(self::StringLiteral | self::InfixExpression[@Operator = '+'][every $part in * satisfies $part[self::StringLiteral]] | self::InfixExpression[@Operator = '+']/*[1][self::StringLiteral] | self::ConditionalExpression/*[position() > 1][self::StringLiteral] | self::MethodCall[@MethodName = ('toCharArray', 'getBytes', 'trim', 'strip', 'toString')]/*[1][self::StringLiteral] | self::MethodCall[@MethodName = 'orElse']/ArgumentList/*[1][self::StringLiteral]) }, $keyed := ('put', 'putIfAbsent', 'setProperty', 'set', 'getProperty', 'getOrDefault') return ( for $site in //VariableDeclarator[$secretName(VariableId/@Name)] return $values($site/*[2])[$hard($text(.), $site/VariableId/@Name)] , for $site in //AssignmentExpression[$secretName(*[1][self::VariableAccess or self::FieldAccess]/@Name)] return $values($site/*[2])[$hard($text(.), $site/*[1]/@Name)] , for $site in //MethodCall[ArgumentList/@Size = 1][$secretName(replace(@MethodName, '^(set|with)([A-Z])', '$2'))] return $values($site/ArgumentList/*[1])[$hard($text(.), $site/@MethodName)] , for $site in //MethodCall[@MethodName = $keyed][ArgumentList/@Size = 2] [ArgumentList/*[1][self::StringLiteral][$secretName(@ConstValue)]] return $values($site/ArgumentList/*[2])[$hard($text(.), $site/ArgumentList/*[1]/@ConstValue)] , for $site in //MethodCall[@MethodName = ('of', 'entry')][*[1][self::TypeExpression/ClassType/@SimpleName = 'Map']] [ArgumentList/@Size mod 2 = 0], $pair in (1 to xs:integer($site/ArgumentList/@Size div 2)) return $values($site/ArgumentList/*[2 * $pair]) [exists($site/ArgumentList/*[2 * $pair - 1][self::StringLiteral][$secretName(@ConstValue)])] [$hard($text(.), $site/ArgumentList/*[2 * $pair - 1]/@ConstValue)] )
